description: This source file implements a WKURLSchemeHandler that serves local files from a specified root directory, resolving paths, handling special cases like index.html, and ensuring security constraints such as preventing directory traversal. It also provides scaffolding and fallbacks when files are missing.

classes.name: CanvasSchemeHandler
classes.description: A class implementing WKURLSchemeHandler to serve files from a local directory with security checks and fallback pages.

methods.name: webView(_:start:)
methods.description: Handles starting a URL scheme task by serving the appropriate file data or error response.

methods.name: webView(_:stop:)
methods.description: No-op method for stopping a task.

methods.name: response(for:)
methods.description: Generates a CanvasResponse containing mime type and data for a given URL, handling path resolution, security checks, and fallback scenarios.

methods.name: resolveFileURL(sessionRoot:requestPath:)
methods.description: Resolves a request path to a file URL within the session root directory, considering index files and directory structures.

methods.name: resolveIndex(in:)
methods.description: Returns the default index file URL within a specified directory if present.

methods.name: isFileURL(_:withinDirectory:)
methods.description: Ensures the file URL is within the allowed directory boundary.

methods.name: html(_:title:)
methods.description: Generates an HTML page with the provided body and optional title.

methods.name: welcomePage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Creates a welcome page instructing the user to create an index.html.

methods.name: scaffoldPage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Provides a default scaffold page or fallback page when no index.html is present.

methods.name: loadBundledResourceData(relativePath:)
methods.description: Loads resource data embedded within the app bundle based on a relative path.

methods.name: textEncodingName(forMimeType:)
methods.description: Returns the appropriate text encoding name for a given MIME type.
